subject: Concept art of one building of a frontier mining colony on a rocky, airless moon of a gas giant, for a sci-fi strategy game. The colony's buildings are one family: modular and industrial, prefabricated hexagonal and rectangular modules, steel-gray plated walls with fine panel lines, dark slate structural frames, thin electric-blue light strips and small blue-lit windows as the only lights; each stands on its own flat hexagonal foundation pad of dark metal. This building is the helium-3 extractor, which gathers helium-3 from the gas giant: a tall slender mast topped with a docking cradle for the small gas-scoop shuttles that skim the giant's atmosphere, beside a cluster of three spherical cryogenic tanks joined by insulated pipes, with pale cyan glowing coolant lines and gauges. Seen in a three-quarter view from slightly above (the camera about 30 degrees above the ground, at a front corner), the whole building and its pad centered with a wide empty margin around it, nothing cut off, on a plain near-black background: no ground, no rocks, no other buildings, no vehicles or people. A clear, readable silhouette; even, clear light so every part reads. No text or lettering anywhere.
style: Clean and neat: one object, whole and readable, on a plain background. Palette: background and dark surfaces in deep navy blacks (#0A0F16, #111722, #192130) and slate blues (#242D41, #3E4D6B); light in electric blue to pale cyan (#4E87BB, #71B2D8, #ACDBE9), the only bright accent; hulls and structures in cool steel grays (#686A79, #97999F). Crisp and sharp everywhere: clean hard edges, fine detail; no haze, no soft focus, no depth-of-field or motion blur. Realistic light, cinematic concept art. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no interface, no lens flares.
